decisions.reason: The green-startup accelerator still features on the home page and costs little to run, but it sits outside the core machinery business, so a small firm with limited slack could cut it if results fall short of aspirations.

The CO2-negative bitumen binder kept its own page in 2024, but it is less prominent and its results are uncertain, which makes it a likely candidate if problemistic search leads to cuts, as with the dropped mobile recycling plant.
The WASTX Cleanic is the firm's flagship, highlighted on the home page in both years and backed by the ERMAFA partnership, so management is likely to keep it while it builds market results.
